policies.title: Annual leave (sample)
policies.body: Sample rule: each full-time employee has 15 days of annual leave per leave year. Unused days lapse at year end.

policies.title: Meal claims (sample)
policies.body: Sample rule: a meal claim needs a receipt and is capped at 200 per day. Submit within 30 days of the receipt date.

policies.title: Medical benefit (sample)
policies.body: Sample rule: the medical benefit covers one general check-up per year after probation.

policies.title: Working hours (sample)
policies.body: Sample rule: core hours are 10:00 to 16:00. Staff agree their remaining hours with their manager.

policies.title: Old travel rule (sample)
policies.body: Sample rule, no longer in force: taxi fares were reimbursed in full.

policies.title: Remote work (sample)
policies.body: Sample draft: remote work on Fridays. Not approved.

policies.title: Parental leave (sample)
policies.body: Sample rule: begins in the future. Twelve weeks of parental leave.

policies.title: 年假政策（樣本）
policies.body: 樣本規則：全職員工每年有十五日年假。
